Terms of Service
Last Updated: September 30, 2026
These Platform Terms of Service (the “Terms”) govern access to and use of the web-based client portal made available by Multiplier Holdings Inc. (“Multiplier”, “we”, “us” or “our”), including the limited licence needed to use its software elements. Please read them carefully. They form a contract between Multiplier and the persons who accept them. If you use the Platform on behalf of an organisation, you also confirm that you have authority to bind that organisation to these Terms.
Important: Multiplier provides the technology platform only. Accounting, tax and other professional services are provided separately by the relevant Portfolio Company under its own engagement letter. Multiplier does not provide accounting, tax, legal, financial or other professional advice through the Platform.
1. Who we are and how these Terms apply
The Platform is operated by Multiplier Holdings Inc., a company incorporated in Delaware under number 7065243, with registered office at 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801, email: info@multiplierholdings.com.
These Terms apply whenever you access or use the Platform, including where the Platform is presented using a Portfolio Company name, logo, domain or other branding.
You agree to be bound by these Terms when you click to accept them.
If you are a Consumer, nothing in these Terms limits or excludes any mandatory rights or remedies available to you under applicable law.
2. Definitions
“Account” means the account or access profile through which a User accesses the Platform.
“AI Features” means the AI-assisted and automated features of the Platform, including the AI assistant, automated feedback and pre-filled responses.
“AI Output” means any content, response, suggestion, feedback or pre-filled information generated by the AI Features.
“Business User” means a User acting wholly or mainly for purposes relating to a trade, business, craft or profession.
“Consumer” means an individual acting wholly or mainly outside that individual’s trade, business, craft or profession.
“Deliverable” means any accounts, return, report, analysis, filing, document or other work product made available by a Portfolio Company through the Platform.
“E-Signature Service” means the third-party electronic-signature functionality made available through the Platform, currently provided through Dropbox Sign or any replacement provider.
“Portfolio Company” means the accounting, tax or other professional-services firm that has invited you to use the Platform or with which you or the organisation you represent has an engagement.
“Professional Services” means accounting, tax, compliance, advisory or other professional services supplied by a Portfolio Company under a separate engagement letter or service agreement.
“Platform” means Multiplier’s browser-based client portal, including its interfaces, workflows, software, systems and related documentation.
“User”, “you” or “your” means the individual accessing or using the Platform and, where relevant, the organisation on whose behalf that individual acts.
“User Content” means information, documents, responses, comments, attachments and other materials uploaded, entered, submitted or otherwise provided by or on behalf of a User through the Platform.
3. The Platform and the Professional Services
The Platform is a technology tool that supports information requests, document exchange, workflow management, collaboration, review, approval and electronic signature between you and a Portfolio Company.
Multiplier does not provide Professional Services and is not a party to the engagement letter or other agreement under which a Portfolio Company provides those services.
The relevant Portfolio Company is solely responsible for the scope, performance, quality, lawfulness and timeliness of the Professional Services and for each Deliverable. Questions about Professional Services or a Deliverable should be directed at that Portfolio Company.
Information displayed through the Platform, including deadlines, requests, status indicators, AI Output and Deliverables, does not constitute advice from Multiplier. Your use of the Platform does not create an accountant-client, adviser-client, fiduciary or other professional relationship with Multiplier.
If there is a conflict concerning Professional Services between these Terms and your engagement letter with a Portfolio Company, the engagement letter governs that conflict. These Terms continue to govern access to and use of the Platform.
4. Eligibility and authority
You must be at least 18 years old, or any higher minimum age required to enter these Terms under the law applicable to you.
If you use the Platform for an organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to act for it and to provide information and instructions on its behalf.
You must not access an Account or workspace unless you are authorised to do so. If your authority changes or ends, you must promptly notify the relevant Portfolio Company.
The relevant Portfolio Company controls User role assignments and the access rights available for each workspace.
5. Account creation, access and security
The relevant Portfolio Company invites you to use the Platform and creates and/or initiates your access. There is no separate public registration process.
Access is generally provided through a single-use link sent to your email address. The link expires within the time limit explained in the email. Optional or required additional authentication may include an authenticator application, passkey or backup codes – all necessary information in this respect will be provided in the email message.
To access and use the Platform, you must have an internet-connected device, an up-to-date internet browser, access to your primary email address and, where required for authentication through Okta, a mobile device running an up-to-date operating system. You are responsible for maintaining these technical requirements and for installing any browser or operating-system updates reasonably required for the secure and proper operation of the Platform.
You must keep your email account, devices, authentication methods and backup codes secure and must not permit another person to use your Account. You are responsible for the activity carried out through your Account unless caused by our breach of these Terms or failure to exercise reasonable care.
You must promptly notify the relevant Portfolio Company if you suspect unauthorised access, lose control of your email account or device, or cease to be authorised to act for an organisation.
If you lose access, you should contact the relevant Portfolio Company. Access may be restored subject to any verification steps communicated to you.
6. Right to use the Platform
Subject to these Terms, Multiplier grants you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable and non-sublicensable right and licence to access and use the Platform during the period in which your access is enabled by a Portfolio Company. You may use the Platform only in connection with the relevant Professional Services and for lawful purposes.
The Platform is hosted and made available through a web browser. No copy of the software forming part of the Platform is sold or transferred to you, and no right is granted to use that software independently of the hosted Platform.
If you act for an organisation, your right to use the Platform is limited to your authorised use on behalf of that organisation and within the workspace or workspaces to which you have been given access.
All rights not expressly granted under these Terms are reserved by Multiplier and its licensors.
The right and licence granted under these Terms does not include any right to receive or obtain source code, object code, a downloadable copy of the software forming part of the Platform, development materials or technical documentation, except where Multiplier expressly agrees otherwise in writing or applicable law provides otherwise.
7. Platform functionality
Depending on the relevant Portfolio Company and engagement, the Platform may enable you to view work items and deadlines, answer questionnaires, respond to information requests, upload and download documents, submit items for review, comment on requests and Deliverables, tag other persons where that functionality is available, approve Deliverables, request changes, sign documents and receive notifications. Where enabled, you may also use the AI Features described below.
The features available to you may differ between Portfolio Companies, engagements, jurisdictions, user roles and over time.
Dates, reminders and status indicators are generated from information provided by the relevant Portfolio Company and are displayed for information and convenience purposes only. You should contact that Portfolio Company if you have any questions about the deadline or action shown on the Platform.
Multiplier provides AI Features as part of the Platform. The relevant Portfolio Company decides whether they are enabled for your engagement, and the Platform will indicate where you are interacting with an AI Feature or where content has been generated or pre-filled by one.
AI Output may be incomplete or inaccurate and is not professional advice from Multiplier or the Portfolio Company. Before submitting information pre-filled and/or suggested by an AI Feature, you should check it against the information and documents available to you and correct any errors you identify. You remain responsible for the information you submit. Automated feedback or validation features may accept or reject a submission without human review. Where this has a material effect on your file, you may ask the relevant Portfolio Company to review that outcome.
The relevant Portfolio Company remains responsible for the Professional Services and Deliverables, including where AI Features were used in preparing them.
Information you enter into the AI Features and the resulting AI Output may be visible to the relevant Portfolio Company and processed by third-party AI providers engaged by Multiplier but will not be used to train AI models. Further information is provided in the applicable privacy notice.
We may develop, modify or discontinue features. Clause 16 explains how material changes are handled, including additional protections for Consumers.
8. Your responsibilities
You must provide information and instructions that are accurate, complete and not misleading, and update them where necessary.
You are responsible for checking that documents and information have been uploaded to the correct workspace, organisation and Portfolio Company before submission.
You must review Deliverables and requests with appropriate care and raise questions, corrections or objections with the Portfolio Company.
You are responsible for securing any copy of a document that you download from the Platform and for complying with any legal, regulatory or contractual record-keeping obligation applicable to you.
9. User Content and permissions
As between you and Multiplier, you retain any rights you have in your User Content.
You grant Multiplier a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to host, copy, transmit, format, display and otherwise process User Content only to operate, secure, maintain and support the Platform, including the AI Features and through third-party providers acting on Multiplier’s behalf, make User Content available to the relevant Portfolio Company and its authorised users, and comply with applicable law.
You confirm that you have the rights and permissions required to provide the User Content and to authorise its use as described in these Terms, including where it contains information about another person.
You must not provide content that is unlawful, infringes third-party rights, contains malicious code, or is materially unrelated to the relevant engagement.
We do not acquire ownership of User Content. Any processing of personal data is addressed in the applicable privacy notice and, where relevant, data-processing arrangements between Multiplier and the Portfolio Company.
10. Documents, storage and deletion
You may be able to upload, download or delete certain documents. A Portfolio Company may also make documents and Deliverables available to you.
Deleting a document from the Platform may not immediately remove every copy where continued retention is required or permitted by applicable law or an applicable retention policy. Further information is provided in the applicable privacy notice.
The Platform is not intended to be your sole archive. You should download and retain copies of documents you are required to keep.
Completed work is currently displayed on the Platform indefinitely. The period for which underlying data is retained may be different.
Retention, restoration and export following termination remain subject to Clause 19, applicable law and the relevant retention policies and professional obligations of Multiplier and the Portfolio Company available here.
11. Comments, approvals and electronic signatures
Comments are linked to individual requests or Deliverables. The Platform does not provide a general chat service.
Comments and attachments may be visible to the relevant Portfolio Company and other authorised users associated with the same workspace or organisation.
Tagging or assigning an item to another person does not by itself establish that the person has authority to approve, submit or sign it.
The Platform may allow you to review a Deliverable, approve it, request changes or sign a document using the E-Signature Service.
Before approving or signing a document, you must review the complete document and confirm that you are authorised to take that action.
The E-Signature Service is provided by a third party and may be subject to additional terms and privacy information presented at the point of use.
The relevant Portfolio Company is responsible for deciding whether a Deliverable or engagement document may be signed using E-signature Service, subject to the applicable law.
12. Electronic communications and notices
You agree that we and the relevant Portfolio Company may communicate with you electronically through the Platform or by email, including in relation to requests, reminders, comments, Deliverables, account security and changes to these Terms.
You must maintain a current email address and monitor your email account and Platform notifications.
Operational notifications are not a substitute for advice or legally required notices from the Portfolio Company unless expressly stated.
Formal notices concerning Professional Services must be sent to the relevant Portfolio Company under its engagement letter.
13. Acceptable use and software restrictions
You must not: (a) use the Platform unlawfully or fraudulently; (b) access data or workspaces without authority; (c) share authentication credentials or circumvent access controls; (d) introduce malware or harmful code; (e) interfere with security, integrity, availability or performance; (f) scrape, harvest, probe or scan the Platform except where expressly permitted; (g) use automated means to access the Platform; (h) copy, reproduce, modify, adapt, translate or create derivative works from the software forming part of the Platform; (i) reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble that software, or attempt to derive its source code or underlying structure; (j) rent, lease, sell, sublicense, distribute, transfer or otherwise commercially exploit that software; (k) remove or alter proprietary, copyright or confidentiality notices; or (l) use that software to develop or improve a competing product or service, or conduct or publish benchmarking, vulnerability testing or security testing, (m) use the AI Features to generate unlawful or misleading content, or attempt to manipulate or bypass their safeguards, all of the above without written authorisation.
Nothing in these Terms restricts any act that applicable law allows despite a contractual restriction, including any applicable right to observe, study or test the functioning of the software forming part of the Platform or to decompile it where the statutory conditions for interoperability or error correction are met.
You must comply with security and use instructions communicated by Multiplier or the relevant Portfolio Company.
We may investigate suspected misuse and preserve relevant evidence, subject to applicable law.
14. Ownership and third-party components
Portfolio Company names, logos, Deliverables and other Portfolio Company content remain owned by the relevant Portfolio Company or its licensors.
Multiplier and its licensors retain all right, title and interest in and to the Platform, including its software, interfaces, design, systems, workflows, documentation, databases, updates and improvements. The Platform is licensed, not sold.
If you provide feedback or suggestions about the Platform, you grant Multiplier a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable and royalty-free right to use and incorporate them for any lawful purpose, provided that Multiplier does not disclose your confidential information in doing so.
The Platform may include or rely on third-party or open-source software components. Where an open-source licence requires separate terms or notices, those terms or notices apply to the relevant component and will be made available as required.
No implied licence or transfer of intellectual-property rights arises under these Terms.
15. Third-party services
The Platform may rely on or connect to third-party services, including electronic-signature, cloud-hosting, authentication and communication and AI services.
We remain responsible for our obligations under these Terms but are not responsible for a third party’s independent services, websites, terms or processing activities except to the extent applicable law provides otherwise.
Third-party services may change, become unavailable or be replaced. We may use a reasonably equivalent replacement where appropriate.
Where you choose to access a third-party service separately, your use may be governed by a direct agreement with that third party.
16. Availability, maintenance and change
Access may be interrupted for planned maintenance, emergency maintenance, security work, upgrades, third-party failure or circumstances outside our reasonable control. You acknowledge that we cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability of the Platform or services and will not be liable to you or any third party for any losses, or other liabilities, whether pecuniary or non-pecuniary, arising from any interruption, suspension, or unavailability of the Platform. If you use the Platform as a consumer the above acknowledgment is subject to the mandatory consumer laws applicable to you.
Because the Platform is hosted, updates, patches, security fixes and feature changes may be deployed automatically without a separate installation by you.
We will provide updates, including security updates, that are necessary to keep the Platform in conformity with these Terms for the period required by applicable law. You must install or enable an update within a reasonable time where this is necessary for the Platform to remain in conformity and where we have informed you of the availability and consequences of failing to install or enable the update. We may modify the Platform to improve it, address security or legal requirements, reflect technical developments or change features. We will not materially reduce core functionality without reasonable notice where required by provision of applicable law.
For Consumers, any modification affecting a digital service will be made only where permitted by applicable law. Where mandatory law requires advance notice, a durable-medium notice, a valid reason, or a right to terminate, we will provide those protections.
We may update these Terms for valid reasons, including legal, regulatory, security, technical or business reasons. The updated version and effective date will be made available through the Platform or by email. Changes will not retroactively reduce accrued rights. Consumer-facing changes remain subject to mandatory law.
17. Suspension and access restrictions
We may suspend or restrict access where necessary to protect security, prevent unauthorised or unlawful use, comply with law or a competent authority, investigate misuse, perform emergency work, or respond to termination or suspension of the related Portfolio Company engagement.
We or the Portfolio Company will explain the reason and expected scope of the restriction. Immediate action may be taken where advance notice would create security, legal or operational risk.
Suspension does not affect rights or obligations accrued before suspension.
18. Confidentiality and privacy
The Platform supports exchanges that may be confidential. You must protect confidential information made available to you and use it only for the relevant engagement, except where disclosure is required by law or authorised by the disclosing party.
Multiplier will apply appropriate confidentiality obligations to personnel and service providers who require access to confidential information for Platform operations.
19. Term and termination
These Terms apply from acceptance until your Platform access ends.
Your access may end when the related Professional Services engagement ends, when the Portfolio Company disables your access, when you cease to be authorised, or when Multiplier terminates or suspends access under these Terms.
You may stop using the Platform at any time. If you are a Consumer, this does not limit any statutory cancellation or termination right.
Before access ends, you should download documents you are entitled and required to retain. Following termination, access, export and retention will be handled in accordance with applicable law, the relevant engagement, professional obligations and the retention policies of Multiplier and the Portfolio Company.
When access ends, the right and licence granted under Clause 6 also end. You must stop using the software forming part of the Platform. Clauses intended by their nature to survive, including Clauses 9, 14, 15, 19 and22 will continue to apply.
20. Warranties and liability
We will provide the Platform in compliance with these Terms.
Subject to mandatory law, we do not warrant that the Platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, compatible with every device or browser, or that all defects will be corrected immediately.
Multiplier does not warrant the accuracy, completeness or legal adequacy of User Content, Portfolio Company content, AI Output, Professional Services or Deliverables.
Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or breach of mandatory consumer rights.
If the Platform does not conform with these Terms and you are a Consumer, you may be entitled to have the Platform brought into conformity free of charge, within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience. Where required by applicable law, you may also be entitled to a proportionate price reduction or to terminate the contract, including where Multiplier has not brought the Platform into conformity, the lack of conformity is sufficiently serious, or it is clear that conformity will not be achieved within a reasonable time or without significant inconvenience.
Multiplier is not responsible for the content, accuracy or professional quality of the Professional Services or Deliverables, or for the professional advice, filing decisions, acts or omissions of a Portfolio Company, except to the extent that the relevant loss was caused by Multiplier’s own breach of these Terms, negligence or other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. This does not affect any direct claim you may have against the Portfolio Company under its engagement letter or applicable law.
For Business Users, neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit, revenue, anticipated savings, business opportunity or goodwill.
Multiplier’s total aggregate liability to a Business User arising out of or in connection with these Terms, whether in contract, tort (including negligence), breach of statutory duty or otherwise, for all claims and causes of action will not exceed the total fees actually paid by the relevant client to the relevant Portfolio Company under the Professional Services engagement directly connected with the circumstances giving rise to the claim.
Each party must take reasonable steps to mitigate loss. Nothing in this Clause restricts a remedy required by mandatory law.
21. Consumer cancellation and mandatory rights
If you are a Consumer, you may have statutory rights concerning digital services, distance contracts, cancellation, conformity, remedies, modifications and termination. These rights vary by jurisdiction and are not excluded by these Terms.
The statutory right of withdrawal and any applicable exceptions are subject to the conditions set out in Appendix 1 and applicable law.
22. Complaints and support
For complaints about Professional Services or a Deliverable, contact the relevant Portfolio Company.
For complaints or support relating to these Terms or the Platform, contact info@multiplierholdings.com. We will handle complaints in accordance with applicable law.
23. General
Governing law. These Terms are governed by the laws of the state of Delaware. If you are a Consumer, this choice does not deprive you of mandatory protections of the law of your residence.
Jurisdiction. The courts of the state of Delaware have jurisdiction for Business Users. Consumers may bring proceedings in any court available under mandatory law, including the courts of their habitual residence where applicable.
Assignment. You may not transfer your rights under these Terms without our consent, except where mandatory law permits. We may transfer these Terms as part of a group reorganisation, financing, sale or transfer of the Platform business, provided this does not reduce a Consumer’s mandatory rights.
Severability. If a provision is invalid or unenforceable, it will be adjusted or severed to the minimum extent necessary and the remaining provisions continue.
Entire agreement. These Terms form the entire agreement between you and Multiplier regarding access to and use of the Platform. They do not replace or affect the engagement letter or other agreement governing Professional Services provided by a Portfolio Company.
Appendix 1: Consumer Right of Withdrawal
This Appendix applies only if you are a Consumer and have a statutory right to withdraw from the contract under applicable law.
A. Information concerning the exercise of the right of withdrawal
Right of withdrawal
You have the right to withdraw from the contract with Multiplier concerning access to and use of the Platform within 14 days without giving any reason.
The withdrawal period will expire 14 days after the day on which the contract is concluded.
To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform Multiplier Holdings Inc., 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801, info@multiplierholdings.com of your decision to withdraw from the contract by an unequivocal statement, for example a letter sent by post or an email. You may use the model withdrawal form set out below, but this is not obligatory. Where required by applicable law, you may also exercise the right of withdrawal using the electronic withdrawal function made available through the relevant online interface.
To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning the exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.
Exceptions from the right of withdrawal
The right of withdrawal does not apply, or may cease to apply, in the circumstances specified by applicable law. In particular:
(a) where the contract concerns a service that has been fully performed during the withdrawal period, you may lose the right of withdrawal if performance began with your prior express consent and after you acknowledged that you would lose the right of withdrawal once the contract had been fully performed; and
(b) where the contract concerns the supply of digital content not supplied on a tangible medium, you may lose the right of withdrawal once performance has begun if you gave your prior express consent to the performance beginning during the withdrawal period, acknowledged that you would thereby lose the right of withdrawal, and received confirmation of the contract in accordance with applicable law.
Effects of withdrawal
If you withdraw from the contract, your right to access and use the Platform under the Terms of Service will end. This does not affect the separate engagement letter or other agreement governing Professional Services supplied by the relevant Portfolio Company.
If you have made any payment directly to Multiplier under the contract, Multiplier will reimburse that payment without undue delay and no later than 14 days after the day on which Multiplier is informed of your decision to withdraw. Unless expressly agreed otherwise, reimbursement will be made using the same means of payment as used for the original transaction, and you will not incur any fee as a result of the reimbursement.
Early commencement of the Platform service
If you ask Multiplier to begin providing access to the Platform during the withdrawal period, the consequences of withdrawal, including any obligation to pay a proportionate amount for services supplied before withdrawal, will apply only to the extent permitted by applicable law. No amount will be payable where the Platform is supplied without a direct charge to you.
